\title{质量预测方法}
\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
工业过程质量预测是制造领域的关键问题。现有方法难以同时处理多阶段约束。本文提出一种约束传播模型，在公开数据集上验证了有效性。
\end{abstract}
\begin{abstract}
Quality prediction is a key problem in manufacturing. Existing methods struggle with multi-stage constraints. This thesis proposes a constraint-propagation model and validates it on public datasets.
\end{abstract}
